_note: The Operator's War Room lines (Logan, 2026-09-27: like an Armored Core handler: busy and to the point, but glad you're alive; mostly updates on what came out of the last mission). All lines are Claude's drafts for Logan to vet. {location}, {mission}, {stops} (the encounter reached), {boss} fill in. Picked (Operator.gd): a saved run waiting -> paused; else a first boss -> boss_first, Recon intel -> recon_intel, a hot Rescue -> rescue_hot; else cleared, or ejected_early / ejected (mid) / ejected_late by how far the run got (Logan, 2026-10-02: not always about ejecting).
first_time: You're up. War table's live. Pick a sector and I'll talk you in.
New frame, same job. War table when you're ready.
Welcome to the War Room, pilot. Everything starts at the table. I'll be in your ear the whole way.
Quiet front for now. Won't last. Table's yours.
paused: You're back from break, I see. Your frame's still prepped at {location}. Say the word and we'll drop you back in.
{mission} at {location} is on hold at encounter {stops}. Everything's where you left it. Table when you're ready.
Coffee's cold and so's your reactor. Ready to finish what you started at {location}?
Command asked about {location}. I told them you were regrouping. Don't make me a liar.
Frame's on standby at {location}. The clock isn't running, but they won't wait forever.
Welcome back. Your sortie at {location} picks up at encounter {stops}. It's on the table.
cleared: {location} is ours. Clean work. Get some rest, then get back on the table.
Sector cleared. Command's pleased, which means they'll want more. Table's open.
{mission} complete at {location}. You came back in one piece. Keep doing that.
All {stops} encounters at {location}, done. I'll make sure logistics hears about it.
Another sector off the board. Take the win, then come find me at the table.
ejected_early: Down at encounter {stops}? That's barely past the drop zone. Shake it off and pick a sector.
Short sortie at {location}. It happens. Check your loadout and go again.
They hit hard and early at {location}. I've got the telemetry. Adjust and go back in.
ejected: Pulled you out at {location}, encounter {stops}. Frame's scrap. You aren't. Next one.
Eject confirmed. I've got your telemetry; we'll do better at {location} next time.
You punched out. Good. Mechs we can replace. Back on the table when you're ready.
ejected_late: Encounter {stops} at {location}. You were nearly through. That one's going to sting. Get back up.
So close at {location}. Whatever stopped you, you know its face now. Next time it's yours.
Deep push. Command noticed, even if the frame didn't make it home. Table's open.
boss_first: {boss}. I knew that pilot. Whatever's in there now, it isn't them. It'll be back.
That was {boss}, or what's left of them. There are more copies out there. Stay sharp.
recon_intel: Recon data's in. Next time we hit a boss, their weapons start cold. Use the opening.
rescue_hot: They were on alert by the end at {location}. Faster next time, or they'll be waiting.
